name: Terminalia arjuna
short: Reviews report no serious side effects so far, but say long-term safety is not established and data on toxicology and drug interactions are scarce.
text: A review of experimental and clinical studies stated that no serious side effects had been reported so far with arjuna therapy, but that its long-term safety still remains to be elucidated. A second review concluded that the plant has a good safety profile when used alongside conventional drugs, while noting a paucity of data on toxicological studies and on its interaction with other drugs. In a 28-day placebo-controlled trial in 44 patients with stage 1 hypertension who were all also taking telmisartan, no adverse events related to the test drug were observed; this was a small, short trial. No specific medicine interactions are named in the cited sources, which describe interaction data as lacking.
